title: Acid staff
body:
"A goblin's favorite tool for melting skeletons into puddles"

Description

The Acid staff is a weapon that is bought from the Goblin Town shop after the Arena has been defeated, it is a long wooden staff with a ball of acid at the end. when used it fires a green projectile similar to the Mysterious mushrooms dealing moderate damage and passing through multiple enemies.

Trivia

-The acid staff serves as a weapon between the Rust breaker and the Rusted Piercer as it has an area of effect and long cooldown but is a ranged weapon and has auto aim like all other weapons in the catagory.

-the acid staff is wielded by the Goblin wizard an enemy rarely found in the Acidlands and in the last two waves of the Arena (it does not drop the weapon)
